title: Emotion Literacy
subtitle: Vocabulary, the Plutchik wheel and its 3 intensities, dyads, valence-arousal, and the 27-emotion overview
intro: Before reading faces at 40 ms, build a precise emotional vocabulary. Explore how emotions vary in intensity (Plutchik wheel), blend into dyads, and map onto continuous dimensions of Valence, Arousal, and Dominance.
